residencyRequirements.description: Either party must be domiciled in Nigeria at the time of filing (MCA s.2). A wife who has been ordinarily resident in Nigeria for at least 3 years immediately preceding the petition is deemed domiciled in Nigeria (MCA s.7(b)). The Rivers State High Court has jurisdiction if either party resides within the state.

waitingPeriod.description: No mandatory waiting period after filing. Decree Nisi becomes Decree Absolute after 3 months (MCA s.58). Cannot petition within 2 years of marriage without leave (MCA s.30).

twoYearBar.description: A petition for dissolution shall not be filed within two years of the date of marriage unless the court grants leave on grounds of exceptional hardship or exceptional depravity (MCA s.30).

noFault.name: 2-Year Separation with Consent
noFault.description: Lived apart 2+ years, respondent does not object.

fault.name: Wilful Refusal to Consummate
fault.description: Respondent has wilfully and persistently refused to consummate.

fault.name: Adultery
fault.description: Respondent committed adultery; petitioner finds it intolerable.

fault.name: Intolerable Behaviour
fault.description: Respondent behaved such that petitioner cannot reasonably live with them.

fault.name: Desertion for One Year
fault.description: Respondent deserted for at least 1 continuous year.

fault.name: Failure to Comply with Restitution Order
fault.description: Respondent failed to comply with conjugal rights order.

fault.name: Presumption of Death (Absent 7 Years)
fault.description: Other party absent for 7+ years, petitioner has no reason to believe them alive.

basic.name: Petition for Dissolution of Marriage
basic.description: Initiates the divorce proceeding under the Matrimonial Causes Act

basic.name: Affidavit in Support of Petition
basic.description: Sworn affidavit verifying the facts stated in the petition

basic.name: Marriage Certificate
basic.description: Original or certified true copy of the marriage certificate under the Marriage Act

legalCitations.code: Matrimonial Causes Act 1970, Cap M7 LFN 2004
legalCitations.description: Federal statute — governs dissolution of marriages contracted under the Marriage Act
Welfare of the child — adopted by Rivers State

filingFees.notes: Filing fees vary by court registry.

childSupportGuidelines.guidelines: Matrimonial Causes Act s.71; Child Rights Act 2003

spousalSupportGuidelines.notes: Court may order maintenance for either spouse.

decreeProcess.decreeNisi: Court grants Decree Nisi after hearing.
decreeProcess.decreeAbsolute: Decree Nisi becomes Decree Absolute after 3 months (MCA s.58).
